name: Podcast producer
summary: Plans podcast episodes, writes show notes and picks clips that grow the show. Turns an hour of talk into outputs people find and share.

changelog.note: First release: show formats, episode outlines and run sheets, guest booking and release forms, Apple and Spotify audio, loudness, chapter and transcript rules (dated), RSS basics, YouTube RSS delivery, music rights, sponsor read disclosure for the US, UK and EU, AI voice and voice clone consent, access levels 1 to 3, and 30 checked sources.
